GeographicArea: Coastal Bend: Nueces, San Patricio, Aransas, Kleberg counties TX
Headline_EN: HURRICANE WATCH for the Coastal Bend. Hurricane Rafael could bring hurricane conditions within 48 hours.
Headline_ES: VIGILANCIA DE HURACAN para el Coastal Bend. El huracan Rafael podria traer condiciones de huracan en 48 horas.

Headline_EN: MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER - Zone A (barrier islands and low-lying surge areas). Leave now. County buses for residents without transportation: call 2-1-1.
Headline_ES: ORDEN DE EVACUACION OBLIGATORIA - Zona A (islas de barrera y areas bajas). Salga ahora. Autobuses del condado para residentes sin transporte: llame al 2-1-1.

Headline_EN: HURRICANE WARNING for Nueces County. Hurricane Rafael, a major hurricane, is expected to make landfall near Port Aransas around 1 AM CDT Tuesday, September 14 with life-threatening storm surge and destructive winds. Complete preparations now and follow evacuation orders from local officials. NWS Corpus Christi.
Headline_ES: ADVERTENCIA DE HURACAN para el Condado de Nueces. Se espera que el huracan Rafael toque tierra cerca de Port Aransas alrededor de la 1 AM del martes 14 de septiembre. Termine sus preparativos ahora.

GeographicArea: Nueces County Evacuation Zones A, B and C
Headline_EN: EVACUATION ORDER Nueces County Zones A B C. LEAVE NOW. Hurricane Rafael Cat 3 arrives 9/14. Take medications, documents, pets. Emergency.Alert.gov
Headline_ES: ORDEN DE EVACUACION Condado de Nueces Zonas A B C. SALGA AHORA. El huracan Rafael categoria 3 llega el 14 de septiembre. Lleve medicinas, documentos, mascotas.

GeographicArea: Corpus Christi Evacuation Zones C, D and E
Headline_EN: City of Corpus Christi: residents of Zones C, D and E who have not left should shelter in place from 8 PM. Stay off the roads. Shelter list: call 2-1-1.
Headline_ES: Ciudad de Corpus Christi: los residentes de las Zonas C, D y E que no hayan salido deben refugiarse en casa desde las 8 PM. No salga a las calles. Albergues: llame al 2-1-1.

Headline_EN: SHELTER IN PLACE. Hurricane Rafael is making landfall. Do not go outside. Life-threatening conditions. Refugiese ahora.
Headline_ES: REFUGIESE DONDE ESTA. El huracan Rafael esta tocando tierra. No salga. Condiciones que amenazan la vida.

Headline_EN: CURFEW in effect dusk to dawn inside Corpus Christi city limits until further notice.

GeographicArea: Within 3 km of the Corpus Christi Ship Channel
Headline_EN: AIR QUALITY HEALTH ADVISORY within 3 km of the ship channel. Benzene measured at 4.8 ppb at Hillcrest. Sensitive groups stay indoors and avoid oiled shorelines.
AlertSource: TCEQ / Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District

GeographicArea: City of Corpus Christi - all water customers
Headline_EN: BOIL WATER NOTICE for all Corpus Christi water customers. Bring water to a rolling boil for two minutes before drinking or cooking. Water distribution sites are open.
Headline_ES: AVISO DE HERVIR EL AGUA para todos los clientes de agua de Corpus Christi. Hierva el agua durante dos minutos antes de beberla o cocinar. Hay sitios de distribucion de agua abiertos.

GeographicArea: Nueces, San Patricio and Aransas counties TX
Headline_EN: MAJOR DISASTER DECLARATION DR-4821-TX for Nueces, San Patricio and Aransas counties covers debris removal and emergency protective measures.

GeographicArea: Nueces Bay and Corpus Christi Bay
Headline_EN: FISHING AND SHELLFISH HARVESTING CLOSED in Nueces and Corpus Christi bays because of the oil spill until further notice.
